title: Boston Gas Company files for approval a 365 Day Transportation Agreement with Carney Hospital.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department APPROVES this proposed Transportation Agreement, also GRANTS the Company's request for protection from public disclosure, pursuant to G.L. c. 25 & 5D. Commissioners participating were: Janet Gail Besser, Chair; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington and Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr. (GC99-14)
